body: This first gulse birsel's movie. I think so good, funny.

That was the movie of last five years of Turkish cinema. Don't even remember last i have that satisfaction feeling. Great scenario, screenplay, acting and of course director did a great job as well. You probably can't that much from elsewhere but gulse birsel.

It's a great action - adventure comedy with lots of going inside. I love how director skips the parts boring audience with perfect skill. For example there is TS person who released by engin gunaydin at some point but instead take that and give that cheap, usual surprise scene that he learns the fact they just ve skip and use joke much worthier elsewhere.

Second most amazing thing about that movie i am not a crime solving guy but there is lots of mystery awaits till end of the film. And most film i know lots of audience wait that flows, blowing ext. But director did it so nice and soft it gives all the expected but making it so smooth and nice that doesnt break that comedy barrier because that is a comedy movie not a crime-investigation.

Looking back a great movie that not for only Turkish people or people who knows Turkish culture well but everyone likes humor.
This film has received good comments everywhere. I do not think so. Overrated. It's an average movie. Acting is good. The screenplay can be estimated.

Like always, she wrote an excellent scenario and collect right person for each role. She is the best comedy producer/author in Turkey. The film is perfect in terms of subject,players, scenario and level. you can watch it all together with your family, girl friend or alone because the language spoken is really levelled.
During the movie, you can find something different to laugh at.
